🍎 Food Escape Race
Ride food and race through the kitchen!
Train your food to gain power — the higher your power, the faster you run!
A crazy chef is chasing right behind you… don’t get caught!

✅ Train power to boost your race speed
😊 Ride all kinds of foods
🚀 Use boost items to accelerate
🍞 Unlock stronger foods and pets
🔪 Fun kitchen theme with chopping training

👑 Become the fastest food rider in the kitchen!
👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
